Definition: from G4862 and a derivative of G5443; a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country:--countryman.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the Thessalonians they suffered like things from their own countrymen, as the churches in Judea suffered from the Jews. Persecution often comes closest to home, from your own people, and that is what makes it cut so deep.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that suffering from your own people is the hardest kind, and I hold that the Thessalonians' patience under it is the pattern for me.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
